Name: Even Better Hay
Author: TurtleWindy
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A replace mod for Better Hay of CatCattyCat without Hopper Patch. [/color]

[size=4][b]EVEN BETTER HAY[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod lets you collect hay even if your silos are full or you don't have any silos. It has config options to fine tune what you want the mod to do (i.e. disable hay dropping on the ground if you have no room in your inventory). Look at config.json for more info![/color][color=#D4D4D8] With default settings, hay first goes to silos, then if those are full it goes to your inventory, then if that is full it drops on the ground.[/color]

[color=#ff0000][b][size=5]!!IMPORTANT!![/size][/b][/color][color=#D4D4D8] [size=5]NO HOPPER PATCH[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod requires[url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases] SMAPI[/url] by Pathoschild. To install the mod, place the BetterHay folder in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. [/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Original Author of Better Hay is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/44734342]CatCattyCat[/url]
